meta.tooltipDescription: HAI serves as a framework for creating systems capable of issuing stablecoins. These stablecoins not only act as a reliable source of collateral for other DeFi protocols—when compared to assets like ETH or BTC—but also function as a store of value, complete with an integrated funding rate.
